claims.text: On the Danny Jones Podcast #181, 16 April 2023, at 3:24, Jeremy Rys cited Seaborg's island-of-stability prediction for superheavy elements against the claim that Bob Lazar predicted element 115. The publication he names was not opened for this node, and the lead map for that episode gives its date inconsistently as May 1969 in one row and May 1989 in another. Nothing here resolves it.

claims.text: On the Danny Jones Podcast, episode 181, 16 April 2023, at 1:15:27, Jeremy Rys credited the first nitinol discovery to the Naval Ordnance Laboratory and dated it 1954. The laboratory is corroborated by the federal record; the date is not. No opened document places any NOL nitinol work before 1961.
